historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission approved the Daughters of the American Colonists' historical plaque in Mountain Lake Park marking the camp site of Juan Bautista de Anza, and had the department furnish a boulder to mount it on.
The Recreation and Park Commission approved Richard Schadt's master plan for Mountain Lake Park, shown in drawings and a scale model.
The Park Commissioners took possession of the Mountain Lake Park reservation, which the Legislature had just put in their charge, and fenced it for $397.92.
With the water low, 6,837 cubic yards of mud were dug out of the bed of Mountain Lake under contract and spread as soil along its banks.
